prompt: Two labeled event groups from one dashcam clip: ENTRY context and CONTACT context. Reference frame 0 suggests the vehicle: null. REFERENCE panels identify a possible counterpart, not additional event candidates. Verify against the whole frames; the proposed reference may be wrong. entry_side is the image LEFT or RIGHT from which the SAME vehicle first entered the camera car driving corridor; trace backwards, not its direction of travel or impact position. evasion_space is 1 if usable physical road space exists for the camera car to continue or steer around it at CONTACT, otherwise 0. Account for traffic, barriers, curbs and road edges; do not judge speed, reaction time or avoidance success. Use full scenes, not the reference crop, to judge space. Return JSON with entry_side and evasion_space only; use null if unknown.
